task_sequence: 3 tasks, distinct pi, shared phi, 720 learning trials/task (80 single + 40 selection per identity); L10 adds a 60-trial bank probe per task
cue_structure: 12 features, signature groups of 4 per task; 4 training pairs, 2 held-out pairs per task

L10-A.criterion: CCM mean forgetting <= 0.10 and final avg >= 0.85

L10-C.criterion: CCM routing accuracy >= 0.90 on every task

L10-D.criterion: CCM held-out cue combination >= 0.80 per task

L10-F.criterion: NO-SEAL mean forgetting > CCM mean forgetting

L10-G.criterion: K2-STRESS worse than CCM (forgetting or final avg)

L10-I.criterion: L1-L9 + STARK-001-007 + Phase-1 gates show no new failures

detail.phase1_gates: PASS 437 assertions, 0 failures (run from stark/); the inherited '19 known failures' reproduce only when the suite is run from a directory without its fixture layout, i.e. they are a working-directory artifact, not a gate regression
detail.fixture_note: test_associative_memory / test_eligibility_gating / test_learned_relevance / test_n_way_learned_relevance require an existing build/dev_bin/ directory in the working directory; they abort without it and pass (exit 0) with it. Verified both ways.

L10-J.criterion: failures and limitations reported honestly; no threshold adapted
L10-J.detail: L10-E and L10-F are reported as FAIL with their measured numbers. The NO-SEAL ablation shows that bank selection, not write protection, is what confines plasticity under this protocol; that negative result is kept. The failed v1.0 engineering run is preserved verbatim.

L10-E2.criterion: correct-context minus context-off >= 0.60 for >= 2 of 3 tasks, and correct-context minus shuffled-cue >= 0.60 for >= 2 of 3 tasks
L10-E2.note: pre-registered clarification of L10-E, recorded in the frozen design §13 before the reported evaluation (the context-off mean is arithmetically floored near 0.33 because the argmax must return one task's mapping correctly)

verdict: L10-A/B/C/D/G/H PASS; L10-E and L10-F FAIL (reported, not relaxed). CCM acquires 3 conflicting mappings with mean forgetting 0.000 and final average 1.000, routes from learned context (routing accuracy 1.000) and generalises to held-out cue combinations (0.997-1.000). Retention depends on context-conditioned bank selection and on supplied capacity (K=3), not on write protection (NO-SEAL ablation identical). See work/dev_context_conditioned_memory_report_STARK-L10-1.md.
